text: The attachment browser test waits for file existence and returns immediately. deleteAttachmentFile attempts IOUtils.remove up to three times, delays 250 ms only before a retry, requests retryReadonly, logs failures, and rethrows the final error. Its callers await deletion. Use this bounded test-cleanup pattern for the same locked-file concern; do not turn it into a general retry policy or hide permanent failures. The commit describes an intermittent file-lock fix attempt, not a reproduced root cause or a proven fix rate. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Retry attachment deletion at the failed operation rather than after every save
